lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno bent back like a bow,
To hand a cup to Kiki, slow!
Kiki laughed, oh what a stretch,
It means you help, not bend and fetch!
[chorus]
Bend over backwards, bend over backwards,
Try so hard to help your friends!
Bend over backwards, bend over backwards,
Do your best until the end!
[verse]
It means you try your very best
To help someone, more than the rest,
You go the extra mile or two,
Because you care, that's what you do!
[chorus]
Bend over backwards, bend over backwards,
Try so hard to help your friends!
Bend over backwards, bend over backwards,
Kindness is a trend that never ends!
[outro]
So when you help with all your might,
You bend over backwards, that's right!
